title: Chain of thought
description: What an assistant did on the way to its answer, folded under one quiet line, after Vercel's AI Elements Chain of Thought. A Collapsible on bits-ui (open bindable, closed by default): ChainOfThoughtHeader (your glyph and words, a caret turning over), ChainOfThoughtContent (an ordered list that unfolds and folds), ChainOfThoughtStep (status done | active | pending; a 1px rail from its icon to the next; a new step fades in and slides 4px into place), ChainOfThoughtStepIcon (a 16px glyph in a 20px column, a dot when empty, hollow while pending), -StepLabel, -StepDescription and -StepContent, which hangs off the rail: ChainOfThoughtSearchResults of ChainOfThoughtSearchResult links, ChainOfThoughtImage with ChainOfThoughtImageCaption, or a paragraph. The step under way is copper, the value in hand, and its glyph breathes. Composition instead of Elements' label, description, icon and caption props. No copy inside.
